<parameter=code>

def region(frame, r0,r1,c0,c1):
    a = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [a[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0,r1)]

def diff_report(name, before, after, r0,r1,c0,c1):
    rb = region(before,r0,r1,c0,c1); ra = region(after,r0,r1,c0,c1)
    ch = [i for i in range(len(rb)) if rb[i]!=ra[i]]
    print(name, "changed rows:", ch)
    for i in ch[:8]:
        print("   ", r0+i, repr(rb[i]), '->', repr(ra[i]))

# Probe A: click small square center then RIGHT
b0 = current_frame
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':54,'col':15},{'action':'RIGHT'}])
diff_report("A small+RIGHT", b0, current_frame, 47,63,11,20)
print("  board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))

# Probe B: click large square center then RIGHT
b1 = current_frame
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30},{'action':'RIGHT'}])
diff_report("B large+RIGHT", b1, current_frame, 47,63,22,38)
print("  board_changed:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
